fields.Name: Skip ICF - Conference NPS Trend
fields.Description: Net Promoter Score by year from the Post-Conference Attendee Survey (MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Responses / Form Response Answers, NPS question). Replaces "Email Engagement Trends" — no email engagement data exists in the ICF world.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Using the post-conference attendee survey, calculate our Net Promoter Score by year (promoters 9-10 minus detractors 0-6, as a percentage of responses) and show it as a line chart with the number of responses per year. Let me click a year to see the individual survey responses. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a line chart of NPS by year
Uses the Post-Conference Attendee Survey responses in the Forms entities (Form Responses / Form Response Answers) and the NPS question
NPS is computed correctly as % promoters minus % detractors, giving values roughly between -5 and +70 (e.g. about 26-35 in 2023-2026)
Response counts per year are shown (about 600 completed responses in total)
Clicking a year shows the individual responses with their NPS score
Rows can open the underlying form response or person record
